content.title: About
content.content: Rice, white, with peas is a ready‑to‑eat product consisting of boiled white rice mixed with cooked green peas. It is commonly served in school cafeterias and used as a quick meal.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The rice‑and‑pea combination provides a more complete amino‑acid profile than rice alone.
The dish is popular in Eastern European and Asian countries as an inexpensive, nutritious option.
Peas add a natural green colour and a subtle sweetness.
The rice is usually pre‑cooked to full tenderness, reducing home‑cooking time.
Packaging often bears the “NS” label (no fat), making it suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Source of complex carbohydrates
items.content: Rice supplies slowly digestible starches that provide sustained energy.

items.title: Rich in plant protein
items.content: Peas contribute a notable amount of plant‑based protein, beneficial for muscle maintenance.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: Peas add fiber that supports healthy digestion.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The product is marked “NS” (no fat), fitting low‑fat dietary plans.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Both rice and peas provide B1, B3 and folate, important for metabolism.

items.title: Pea allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to peas.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: White rice has a high GI, so people with diabetes should monitor portion sizes.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Some packages may contain added salt; check the label if you need a low‑sodium product.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The product is ready to eat straight from the pack. It can be warmed in a microwave or on the stove, and paired with sauces, vegetables or meat for variety.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a dry, cool place away from direct light. After opening, keep the package tightly sealed to prevent moisture absorption.
